Headline: Promoter Shares of CCBL and SLICL Converted to Ordinary Shares
Full Content:
22,97,683.88 units promoter shares of
Century Commercial Bank Limited (CCBL)
have been converted to ordinary shares.
With this, the Promoter to Public share ratio of the company is now 51: 49. The 11th AGM of the company held on 30th Poush, 2078 had endorsed changing the promoter shareholding from 53.41% to 51%.
As of writing, CCBL has an LTP of Rs. 224.70.
Similarly, 22,95,254 units promoter shares of
Surya Life Insurance Company Limited (SLICL)
have also been converted to ordinary shares.
With this, the Promoter to Public share ratio of the company is now 51: 49. The 13th AGM of the company held on Poush 19 endorsed changing the shareholding ratio from 60: 40 to 51: 49.
As of writing, SLICL has an LTP of Rs. 739.

Headline: 22.95 Lakh Additional Share Supply of Surya Life Insurance (SLICL) to Enter Secondary Market, Company Converting Promoter Shares
Full Content:
Surya Life Insurance Company Limited (SLICL)
is making changes to its shareholding ratio by converting a portion of promoter shares to ordinary shares.
Currently, the promoter to the public shareholding ratio of the company is 60: 40. As of writing, the paid-up capital of the company is Rs. 255 crores. Thus, promoters own 60,% i.e. 153 crores of the paid-up capital, and the public shareholders own 40%, i.e. 102 crores.
The company wants to bring the ratio down to 51: 49 by converting a portion of promoter shares to ordinary shares. Thus, 22.95 lakh promoter shares will be converted to ordinary shares. This will mean an additional supply of the same quantity of shares that will be traded in the secondary market as ordinary shares.
Promoters unwilling to convert their portion of the shares can submit a self-declaration within 7 days to the company's corporate office, Sano Gaucharan, Kathmandu.

Headline: NIC Asia Bank Reauctioning Promoter Shares of CIT, NLICL, and SLICL
Full Content:
NIC Asia Bank Limited will reauction the promoter shares of three companies from today, i.e. Magh 20. It will conclude on 26th Magh.
1,82,560 units promoter share of (Citizen Investment Trust), 92,266 units of promoter share of (National Life Insurance Company Limited), and 1,73,844 units promoter shares of (Surya Life Insurance Company Limited) are being auctioned.
NIC Asia bank had previously auctioned the shares of these companies. 2,02,560 units promoter share of (Citizen Investment Trust), 94,866 units of promoter share of (National Life Insurance Company Limited), and 1,85,694 units promoter shares of (Surya Life Insurance Company Limited) were auctioned.
Only banks, financial institutions, and insurance companies are allowed to bid for the auction of Citizen Investment Trust's shares. Meanwhile, all eligible investors can bid for the auction of promoter shares of other companies.
The minimum bid rates for the promoter shares of CIT, NLICL, SLICL are Rs. 1,623, Rs. 530, and Rs. 379 respectively. The minimum bid rates in the previous auction were Rs. 1,384, Rs. 482, and Rs. 365 respectively. While the minimum bid quantity is 100 units for all the auctions, there is no upper limit. Although bidders can bid for the entirety of the issue, they are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity. Meanwhile, any quantity in between should be divisible by 10.
